title: Heavy script load
summary: Homepage loads 63 scripts, likely slowing interaction readiness and hurting conversion.
problem: The homepage loads 63 scripts, which is the usual root cause of slow interaction readiness on mobile.
recommended_change: notes: Audit third-party tags, defer non-critical scripts, and remove duplicated analytics or marketing pixels.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 inline and 22 external <script> tags, 698 KB of HTML.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: Unlabelled controls
summary: 41 of 79 buttons have no accessible name, making them unusable for assistive technology users.
problem: 41 of 79 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
recommended_change: notes: Give every control a visible text label or an aria-label. WCAG 2.2 AA, success criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 41 of 79 <button> elements contain no text content and no aria-label.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

title: Missing alt text
summary: 3 images lack alt text, losing assistive tech support and image-search traffic.
problem: 3 of 43 images carry no alt attribute, losing both assistive technology support and the image-search traffic the alt text earns.
recommended_change: notes: Add descriptive alt text; use alt="" only for decorative images.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 3 of 43 elements have no alt attribute.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift
